overview: Three things take you everywhere in the app: the **tabs** along the bottom, the **Discover** sheet, and your **profile menu**. Search, the bell and Saathi are on hand from Home.

rules: A member acting for a company sees that company's rows here too, and the chapters of Part 3 show each one.
The same menu is where you switch between yourself and a company you belong to.
The app checks for new notifications about once a minute while it is open. It does not send alerts to your lock screen yet; ICR also emails you about the kinds you leave switched on (see Settings).
The gear at the top right opens your notification preferences.
Saathi explains how ICR works and points to the right page. It does not act for you: it will not apply, post or pay.
